name: Pixel Art: Location Interior
description: Image preset for a location interior in the Pixel Art look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an interior. List the room's purpose, three props that say who uses it, and the light source from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: interior view of the location from a doorway or corner, key furniture and props in place, light source visible, room for characters to stand, pixel art, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited 16 to 32 colour palette, readable silhouette at low resolution, no anti-aliasing, deliberate dithering, single consistent light direction, high-contrast outline against the background
negative_prompt: smooth gradients, anti-aliasing, blur, photorealistic, 3d render, mixed pixel sizes, text, watermark
